schema.text: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while riding (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?
schema.help: A junction with poor visibility is one where buildings, walls or parked vehicles hide traffic coming from the side.

options.text: Completely confident — I feel well prepared for the typical hazards
Very confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
Fairly confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations

en.#How confident are you in your ability t: How confident are you in your ability to anticipate and react to dangerous situations while riding (e.g., car doors opening suddenly, vehicles cutting across, or blind junctions)?
en.#A junction with poor visibility is one: A junction with poor visibility is one where buildings, walls or parked vehicles hide traffic coming from the side.
en.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Not confident at all — I feel unprepared for these situations
en.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Slightly confident — I am aware of the risks but often feel caught off guard
en.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: Fairly confident — I manage most situations but some still worry me
en.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: Very confident — I anticipate most hazards and respond well
en.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: Completely confident — I feel well prepared for the typical hazards

it.#How confident are you in your ability t: Quanto ti senti capace di prevedere e affrontare situazioni pericolose mentre sei in bici o in monopattino, ad esempio portiere di auto che si aprono improvvisamente, veicoli che tagliano la strada o incroci con scarsa visibilità?
it.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Un incrocio con scarsa visibilità è un incrocio dove edifici, muri o veicoli parcheggiati nascondono il traffico che arriva di lato.
it.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Per niente capace — mi sento impreparato/a ad affrontare queste situazioni
it.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Poco capace — sono consapevole dei rischi, ma spesso vengo colto/a di sorpresa
it.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: Abbastanza capace — gestisco la maggior parte delle situazioni, ma alcune mi preoccupano ancora
it.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: Molto capace — prevedo la maggior parte dei pericoli e reagisco bene
it.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: Del tutto capace — mi sento ben preparato/a ad affrontare i pericoli tipici

fr.#How confident are you in your ability t: À quel point vous sentez-vous capable d’anticiper et de réagir aux situations dangereuses à vélo ou en trottinette, par exemple une portière qui s’ouvre soudainement, un véhicule qui coupe votre trajectoire ou un carrefour avec mauvaise visibilité ?
fr.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Un carrefour avec mauvaise visibilité est un carrefour où des bâtiments, des murs ou des véhicules garés cachent la circulation venant du côté.
fr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Pas du tout en confiance — je ne me sens pas préparé(e) à ces situations
fr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Un peu en confiance — je connais les risques, mais je suis souvent surpris(e)
fr.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: Plutôt en confiance — je gère la plupart des situations, mais certaines m’inquiètent encore
fr.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: Très en confiance — j’anticipe la plupart des dangers et je réagis correctement
fr.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: Tout à fait en confiance — je me sens bien préparé(e) aux dangers habituels

de.#How confident are you in your ability t: Wie sicher fühlen Sie sich darin, gefährliche Situationen mit dem Fahrrad oder E-Scooter früh zu erkennen und darauf zu reagieren, zum Beispiel plötzlich geöffnete Autotüren, abbiegende Fahrzeuge oder unübersichtliche Kreuzungen?
de.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Eine unübersichtliche Kreuzung ist eine Kreuzung, an der Gebäude, Mauern oder parkende Fahrzeuge den seitlich kommenden Verkehr verdecken.
de.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Gar nicht sicher — ich fühle mich auf solche Situationen nicht vorbereitet
de.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Etwas sicher — ich kenne die Risiken, werde aber oft überrascht
de.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: Ziemlich sicher — ich komme mit den meisten Situationen zurecht, manche machen mir aber noch Sorgen
de.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: Sehr sicher — ich erkenne die meisten Gefahren früh und reagiere gut
de.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: Völlig sicher — ich fühle mich auf die typischen Gefahren gut vorbereitet

tr.#How confident are you in your ability t: Bisiklet veya elektrikli scooter kullanırken tehlikeli durumları önceden fark edip tepki verme becerinize ne kadar güveniyorsunuz? Örneğin aniden açılan otomobil kapıları, önünüzü kesen araçlar veya görüşü kısıtlı kavşaklar.
tr.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Görüşü kısıtlı kavşak, binaların, duvarların ya da park etmiş araçların yandan gelen trafiği gizlediği kavşaktır.
tr.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Hiç güvende hissetmiyorum — bu durumlara hazırlıklı hissetmiyorum
tr.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Biraz güvende hissediyorum — riskleri biliyorum ama sık sık hazırlıksız yakalanıyorum
tr.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: Oldukça güveniyorum — çoğu durumla başa çıkıyorum ama bazıları hâlâ beni endişelendiriyor
tr.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: Çok güveniyorum — çoğu tehlikeyi önceden fark edip uygun şekilde tepki veriyorum
tr.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: Tamamen güveniyorum — tipik tehlikelere iyi hazırlandığımı düşünüyorum

fa.#How confident are you in your ability t: در پیش‌بینی و واکنش به موقعیت‌های خطرناک هنگام استفاده از دوچرخه یا اسکوتر برقی چقدر به توانایی خود اطمینان دارید؟ مثلاً باز شدن ناگهانی در خودرو، پیچیدن خودرو جلوی شما یا تقاطع با دید محدود.
fa.#A junction with poor visibility is one: تقاطع با دید محدود تقاطعی است که در آن ساختمان‌ها، دیوارها یا خودروهای پارک‌شده ترافیکی را که از کنار می‌آید پنهان می‌کنند.
fa.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: اصلاً مطمئن نیستم — برای این موقعیت‌ها آماده نیستم
fa.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: کمی مطمئنم — خطرها را می‌شناسم اما اغلب غافلگیر می‌شوم
fa.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: نسبتاً مطمئنم — بیشتر موقعیت‌ها را مدیریت می‌کنم، اما بعضی هنوز نگرانم می‌کنند
fa.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: خیلی مطمئنم — بیشتر خطرها را از قبل تشخیص می‌دهم و خوب واکنش نشان می‌دهم
fa.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: کاملاً مطمئنم — برای خطرهای معمول آمادگی خوبی دارم

hu.#How confident are you in your ability t: Mennyire bízik abban, hogy kerékpározás vagy rollerezés közben előre felismeri és kezeli a veszélyes helyzeteket, például hirtelen kinyíló autóajtót, elé forduló járművet vagy beláthatatlan kereszteződést?
hu.#A junction with poor visibility is one: Beláthatatlan kereszteződés az, ahol épületek, falak vagy parkoló járművek eltakarják az oldalról érkező forgalmat.
hu.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: Egyáltalán nem vagyok magabiztos — nem érzem magam felkészültnek ezekre a helyzetekre
hu.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: Kissé magabiztos vagyok — ismerem a kockázatokat, de gyakran váratlanul érnek
hu.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: Elég magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb helyzetet kezelem, de néhány még aggaszt
hu.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: Nagyon magabiztos vagyok — a legtöbb veszélyt előre észreveszem és megfelelően reagálok
hu.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: Teljesen magabiztos vagyok — jól felkészültnek érzem magam a tipikus veszélyekre

ar.#How confident are you in your ability t: ما مدى ثقتك في قدرتك على توقع المواقف الخطرة والتعامل معها أثناء ركوب الدراجة أو السكوتر الكهربائي، مثل فتح باب سيارة فجأة أو قطع مركبة لطريقك أو تقاطع محدود الرؤية؟
ar.#A junction with poor visibility is one: التقاطع محدود الرؤية هو تقاطع تحجب فيه المباني أو الجدران أو المركبات المتوقفة حركة المرور القادمة من الجانب.
ar.#Not confident at all — I feel unprepare: لست واثقًا إطلاقًا — لا أشعر أنني مستعد لهذه المواقف
ar.#Slightly confident — I am aware of the: واثق قليلًا — أعرف المخاطر لكنني أفاجأ بها كثيرًا
ar.#Fairly confident — I manage most situat: واثق إلى حد ما — أتعامل مع معظم المواقف لكن بعضها ما زال يقلقني
ar.#Very confident — I anticipate most haza: واثق جدًا — أتوقع معظم المخاطر وأستجيب جيدًا
ar.#Completely confident — I feel well prep: واثق تمامًا — أشعر أنني مستعد جيدًا للمخاطر المعتادة
